memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Follow‑up of worsening joint pain and fatigue.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: The patient reports increasing pain and stiffness in both hands and knees over the past 6 weeks, worse in the mornings, lasting about an hour. He also notes low‑grade fatigue and occasional low back discomfort. No fever, rash, or weight loss.

EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 78 kg, BMI 27.0 (obese). Tender and swollen metacarpophalangeal joints bilaterally, wrists mildly swollen. Knees show mild effusion. No skin nodules. Lung and cardiac exams normal.

IMPRESSION: Active rheumatoid arthritis, likely moderate severity. Vitamin D deficiency suspected given low sun exposure and musculoskeletal pain. Plan to check inflammatory markers and vitamin D level.

ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D, calcium, phosphate, ESR, CRP, rheumatoid factor, anti‑CCP, and liver function tests. Start cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD, methotrexate 10 mg once weekly, folic acid 5 mg once weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD. Advise weight‑reducing diet and regular low‑impact exercise as BMI is obese. Offer influenza vaccine; patient to receive in autumn. Return if new joint swelling, fever >39 °C, breathlessness, chest pain, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Review of rheumatoid arthritis and vitamin D repletion.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient says morning stiffness has decreased from 60 to 30 minutes; hand pain is milder. He still feels tired after work. No new joint swelling.

EXAMINATION: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 76 kg, BMI 26.2 (obese). Tender MCP joints less pronounced; no synovitis. Knees non‑effused.

IMPRESSION: Partial response to methotrexate and HCQ. Vitamin D level expected to have risen with loading dose. Continue current DMARDs, consider methotrexate dose increase if symptoms persist.

ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D, calcium, phosphate, ESR, CRP, LFT. Increase methotrexate to 15 mg once weekly if liver enzymes remain normal. Continue folic acid 5 mg weekly, HCQ 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD. Advise maintain calorie‑restricted diet and daily walking as BMI remains obese. Influenza vaccine to be given in October. Return if worsening joint pain, fever >39 °C, shortness of breath, or abnormal bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Follow‑up after patient‑reported knee discomfort.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports mild right knee pain on stairs, no swelling; hand joints comfortable. Fatigue unchanged.

EXAMINATION: BP 128/80 mmHg, weight 75 kg, BMI 25.9 (obese). Right knee mildly tender on medial joint line, no effusion. Hands non‑tender.

IMPRESSION: Mild mechanical knee pain likely early osteoarthritis; rheumatoid arthritis well‑controlled. Vitamin D now sufficient.

ARRANGEMENTS: Continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, HCQ 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD. Advise quadriceps strengthening, weight loss, and avoid prolonged kneeling. Order repeat vitamin D level in 3 months to confirm maintenance. Influenza vaccine due; schedule for 2025-10-15. Return if knee swelling, fever >39 °C, worsening joint pain, or breathing difficulty.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual review of rheumatoid arthritis and metabolic health.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient states joints feel good, no morning stiffness, able to work full days. No new symptoms.

EXAMINATION: BP 126/78 mmHg, weight 73 kg, BMI 25.2 (obese). No joint swelling or tenderness.

IMPRESSION: Rheumatoid arthritis in remission on current DMARDs. Vitamin D adequate. Lipids and glucose within target.

ARRANGEMENTS: Continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, HCQ 200 mg OD, prednisolone taper to 2.5 mg OD for 4 weeks then stop if no flare. Advise maintain Mediterranean‑style diet and regular aerobic activity as BMI remains obese. Influenza vaccine given 2025-10-15 documented; next dose due autumn 2026. Return if new joint pain/swelling, fever >39 °C, unexplained weight loss, or chest pain.
